findings.title: Double-Refund Race on Concurrent Requests
findings.spec_quote: Make sure we don't refund more than the original charge.
findings.monkeys_paw_grant: A literal agent reads `charge.refunded_cents` in Python memory, checks `refunded_cents + request.amount_cents <= amount_cents`, calls Stripe, and writes back. Double-clicking the Refund button or parallel tabs both pass the read check at t=0ms and issue two Stripe refunds totaling 200% of the payment.

option_a.label: Pessimistic Row Lock + SQL Check Constraint
option_a.design: Acquire `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE NOWAIT` on `charges` inside a DB transaction, enforce `CHECK (refunded_cents <= amount_cents)` on `charges`, and derive a deterministic Stripe idempotency key from `(charge_id, refund_seq)`.

option_b.label: Client Idempotency Key Table + Optimistic Version CAS
option_b.design: Require an `Idempotency-Key` UUID header persisted in `refund_idempotency_keys` and execute `UPDATE charges SET refunded_cents = refunded_cents + :amt, version = version + 1 WHERE id = :id AND version = :ver AND refunded_cents + :amt <= amount_cents`.

findings.pm_tradeoff: Option A blocks simultaneous double-clicks immediately with a clear 'Refund already in progress' banner and zero extra UI state (ships 1 day faster). Option B silently replays the same receipt on network retries without error banners (+1 schema table).

resolution.rationale: Dashboard runs on desktop browsers; immediate 409 lock guard + SQL CHECK constraint eliminates double-refund risk cleanly.
ears_clauses: WHEN `POST /v1/charges/{charge_id}/refund` is invoked, THE SYSTEM SHALL acquire a `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE NOWAIT` lock on `charges` before evaluating `refunded_cents + refund_amount_cents <= amount_cents`.

IF a concurrent transaction holds the row lock on `charges` or `refunded_cents + refund_amount_cents > amount_cents`, THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL abort before calling Stripe and return HTTP 409 Conflict or HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity respectively.

findings.title: Split-Brain Ledger When DB Commit Fails Post-Stripe Refund
findings.spec_quote: issue full or partial refunds via Stripe, update the order status to `REFUNDED`, and send the customer a confirmation email.
findings.monkeys_paw_grant: Agent calls `stripe.Refund.create()` synchronously inside the route handler, then updates `Order.status = 'REFUNDED'` and calls SendGrid. First, a partial refund wrongly marks the entire order `REFUNDED`; second, if Postgres or SendGrid times out after Stripe succeeds, money leaves the platform while the ledger still shows `PAID`.

option_a.label: Two-Phase RefundAttempt Ledger + Webhook Reconciliation
option_a.design: Commit a `refund_attempts` row (`status='PENDING'`) with deterministic key `refund:{attempt_id}` before calling Stripe; transition order to `PARTIALLY_REFUNDED` when `0 < refunded_cents < amount_cents` and `REFUNDED` only at full amount; enqueue email via worker on `charge.refunded`.

option_b.label: Async Transactional Outbox Queue
option_b.design: Write `refund_outbox` record atomically in Postgres and return `202 Accepted` (`REFUND_PROCESSING`); background Celery worker executes Stripe refund, reconciles ledger state, and dispatches confirmation email.

findings.pm_tradeoff: Option A gives the merchant an instant confirmed/failed receipt in ~600ms while distinguishing 'Partially Refunded' from 'Refunded'. Option B returns a 'Processing refund...' spinner for 2-5 seconds and requires polling on the Charge Details page.

resolution.rationale: Merchants expect immediate confirmation when on the phone with a customer, and partial refunds must not mark full orders refunded.
ears_clauses: WHEN a refund request passes validation, THE SYSTEM SHALL persist a `refund_attempts` record in `PENDING` status prior to invoking `stripe.Refund.create(idempotency_key=attempt_id)`.

WHEN `refunded_cents` is greater than `0` and less than `amount_cents`, THE SYSTEM SHALL set `Order.status` to `PARTIALLY_REFUNDED`, transitioning `Order.status` to `REFUNDED` only when `refunded_cents == amount_cents`.

WHEN the `refund_attempts` record transitions to `SUCCEEDED` (synchronously or via `charge.refunded` webhook), THE SYSTEM SHALL enqueue the customer confirmation email asynchronously so SMTP latency cannot roll back ledger persistence.

findings.title: Cross-Merchant IDOR and Uncapped Support Agent Refunds
findings.spec_quote: Add a 'Refund Payment' button on the Charge Details page (`POST /v1/charges/{charge_id}/refund`) in the Merchant Dashboard so merchants and support agents can issue full or partial refunds
findings.monkeys_paw_grant: Agent attaches generic `Depends(get_current_user)` and fetches `Charge.by_id(charge_id)`. Any authenticated merchant viewer can guess or enumerate `charge_id` values belonging to other merchants, and tier-1 support contractors can drain `$50,000` enterprise charges unilaterally.

option_a.label: Strict Tenant Scoping + Owner/Finance RBAC Gate
option_a.design: Scope charge lookup by `(id = :charge_id AND merchant_id = :actor.merchant_id)` for merchant tokens (returning 404 on mismatch), restrict merchant roles to `MERCHANT_OWNER` / `MERCHANT_FINANCE`, and cap `INTERNAL_SUPPORT` single-charge refunds at `$250` with audit log actor recording.

option_b.label: Tenant Scoping + Dual-Control Approval Workflow
option_b.design: Enforce tenant scoping plus a `refund_approvals` state machine where `INTERNAL_SUPPORT` or `MERCHANT_MEMBER` can draft refunds above `$250` that pause in `AWAITING_APPROVAL` until a `FINANCE_ADMIN` approves.

findings.pm_tradeoff: Option A ships immediately: support resolves 95% of everyday tickets (<=$250) in one click and escalates high-value refunds to Finance. Option B adds an approval inbox UI (+3 days engineering scope).

resolution.rationale: 96% of Zendesk refund tickets are under $250; the dual-control inbox can be parked for Phase 2.
ears_clauses: WHEN a merchant-scoped caller invokes `POST /v1/charges/{charge_id}/refund`, THE SYSTEM SHALL filter the target charge by `id = charge_id AND merchant_id = caller.merchant_id` and require role `MERCHANT_OWNER` or `MERCHANT_FINANCE`, returning HTTP 404 on tenant mismatch and HTTP 403 on insufficient role.

WHEN a caller with role `INTERNAL_SUPPORT` requests a refund exceeding `25000` cents ($250.00), THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the request with HTTP 403 Forbidden and record the blocked attempt in `audit_events`.

findings.title: Refunded Subscription Charge Leaves Paid Entitlements Active
findings.spec_quote: update the order status to `REFUNDED`, and send the customer a confirmation email.
findings.monkeys_paw_grant: Agent updates `orders.status = 'REFUNDED'` while leaving the linked `entitlements` cache and `api_quotas` row active until next year's renewal—allowing users to buy an annual plan, claim an immediate full refund, and retain paid Pro seats for 12 months.

option_a.label: Automatic Entitlement Revocation on Full Refund
option_a.design: When a charge achieves 100% `REFUNDED` status, revoke linked `entitlements` (`status='REVOKED_REFUND'`) and invalidate the Redis entitlement key; preserve active entitlements on partial goodwill/proration refunds.

option_b.label: Explicit `revoke_access` Boolean Toggle on Refund Request
option_b.design: Add required `revoke_entitlements: bool` field to `RefundRequestSchema` (default `true` for full refunds, `false` for partial refunds) so operators explicitly choose whether goodwill credit keeps access active.

findings.pm_tradeoff: Option A has zero extra form clutter—full refunds revoke paid seats automatically while partial refunds keep the customer active. Option B adds a checkbox to the Refund modal so support can grant a 100% outage refund without cutting off access.

resolution.rationale: Support occasionally grants 100% refunds for SLA incidents where revoking customer seats would worsen the escalation.
ears_clauses: WHEN `POST /v1/charges/{charge_id}/refund` is submitted, THE SYSTEM SHALL accept an explicit `revoke_entitlements` boolean (defaulting to `true` when `refund_amount_cents == remaining_refundable_cents` and `false` otherwise).

WHEN a refund succeeds with `revoke_entitlements == true`, THE SYSTEM SHALL set linked `entitlements.status = 'REVOKED_REFUND'` and evict the tenant's cached entitlement entry within the same workflow.
